title: Fast Computation of Lowest Common Ancestor in Version Control Commit Graph
abstract: arXiv:2611.25912v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The problem of finding the lowest common ancestor in the commit graph arises when a user wants to merge two (or more) development branches: for example, to add their own development into a common branch. At that moment, the version control system must determine the merge base - the common ancestor of the latest commits of the branches, in order to show the mutual difference between the branches. The problem is complicated by the fact that the commit graph is not a tree but an arbitrary acyclic graph. Moreover, if there is no common ancestor, searching for one may require traversing the entire graph. Traversing a graph with several million vertices takes tens of seconds, which becomes noticeable to users.   We show that the commit graph has additional structure - supporting branches - and that this can be used to speed up the algorithm. translated_title: 版本控制提交图中最近公共祖先的快速计算
translated_abstract: 当用户想要合并两个（或多个）开发分支时，例如将自己的开发内容合入公共分支，就会出现在提交图中查找最近公共祖先的问题。此时，版本控制系统必须确定合并基准——即各分支最新提交的共同祖先，以便展示分支之间的相互差异。该问题的复杂之处在于，提交图并不是一棵树，而是一个任意的无环图。此外，如果不存在共同祖先，查找过程可能需要遍历整个图。遍历一个拥有数百万个顶点的图需要数十秒，这种延迟对用户来说是显而易见的。我们证明了提交图具有额外的结构——支撑分支，并且可以利用这一结构来加速算法。通过提取支撑分支，可以对图进行预处理，从而加速最近公共祖先的查找。
tldr: 该论文发现版本控制提交图中存在“支撑分支”这一额外结构，通过提取该结构进行预处理，可显著加速在提交图中查找最近公共祖先（合并基准）的算法。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that version control commit graphs possess an additional structure of "supporting branches," which can be extracted and preprocessed to significantly speed up the lowest common ancestor (merge base) search algorithm.
